title: Aithema foundation contracts: shared definitions
description: Shared value types and the version envelope (§9.7). Every top-level contract document carries contract, major, minor and min_reader; a reader executes it only for a supported major with reader_minor ≥ min_reader, otherwise it refuses with contract_too_new. Amendment (AIT-35): §9.7 names the major field settings_version; the foundation contracts, and aithema.settings/1 later, use `major` uniformly.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC profile: the date must exist and seconds are 00–59 (leap seconds are not represented; hosts record :59). Validated beyond the pattern.

host_mode.description: review: confirmed items are submitted to the host and a person accepts them there. working_spec_only (AIT-78): anonymous or approver-less intake; nothing is submitted or accepted, and the handover package is exported with provenance at session end.
